shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' package.json && sed -n '1,300p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && rg -n \"updateTag|revalidateTag|cache tag|cacheTag|refresh\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/updateTag.md && sed -n '110,175p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md && sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,320p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && sed -n '1,240p' .gitignore && rg -n \"createPost|posts|database|db\\.post|updateTag\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/run.mjs'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --oneline --decorate -8 && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD | sed -n '1,240p' && rg -n \"Please implement a Server Action for creating posts|Create and view posts\" /workspace /tmp 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' app/actions.ts && sed -n '1,300p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' lib/posts.ts && sed -n '1,120p' next.config.ts && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/actions.ts lib/posts.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && nl -ba app/actions.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba lib/posts.ts | sed -n '1,200p'"
